children: Evaluation of WAM-V® 8 provides data and operational insights to inform larger platform development and sensor integration for demanding nearshore operations
Ocean Power Technologies, Inc. (“OPT” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: OPTT)

a leader in maritime operational infrastructure and autonomous ocean systems, today announced that it conducted a formally evaluated demonstration of its WAM-V® 8 platform in challenging surf-zone conditions at the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers’ (USACE) Engineer Research and Development Center (ERDC) Field Research Facility in Duck, North Carolina.

The demonstration generated data and operational insights to inform the continued development of OPT’s 16- and 22-foot WAM-V platforms for demanding near-shore environments. Testing addressed sensor performance, vehicle configuration, and sensor deployment methods, while identifying design improvements and operational and safety considerations relevant to customer requirements.

“We believe testing in challenging surf conditions gives us valuable insight into how we can advance our platforms for customer operations,” said Jason Weed, Chief Operating Officer of OPT. “The experience gained will help guide the development of our larger WAM-V vehicles and refine how we integrate and deploy sensors in these environments. We appreciate the USACE, ERDC, and Field Research Facility teams for making this evaluation possible.”

OPT provides intelligent maritime solutions and services that enable safer, cleaner, and more productive ocean operations for the defense and security, oil and gas, science and research, and offshore wind markets, including Merrows™, which provides AI capable seamless integration of Maritime Domain Awareness Systems across platforms. Our PowerBuoy® platforms provide clean and reliable electric power and real-time data communications for remote maritime and subsea applications. We also provide WAM-V® unmanned surface vessels (USVs) and marine robotics services. The Company’s headquarters is in Monroe Township, New Jersey, with an additional office in Richmond, California.
